data.name: Privacy.Intro
data.value: Lernkicker is a private learning app for families. It runs on a server at the home of the person who runs Lernkicker and invited you. That person is responsible for the data.

data.name: Privacy.StoredParents
data.value: Parents: name, email address (for logging in) and an encrypted password.

data.name: Privacy.StoredChildren
data.value: Children: only a first name or nickname, the grade and an encrypted PIN. No date of birth, no photo.

data.name: Privacy.StoredQuizzes
data.value: The uploaded practice tests, which test is assigned to which child, and the results.

data.name: Privacy.StoredDevices
data.value: Which phones are connected to a child (label and time of last use).

data.name: Privacy.Who
data.value: Only the parents of a family see that family's children, tests and results. Other families see none of it. The person who runs Lernkicker manages families but does not see other children's results.

data.name: Privacy.Sharing
data.value: There are no ads, no analytics and no external fonts. Data is not passed on to anyone.

data.name: Privacy.Telegram
data.value: Telegram is optional. If a parent connects Telegram, the messages to that parent (child names, quiz titles, results and dates) go through Telegram's servers and are stored there under Telegram's privacy policy. Disconnecting stops this at once.

data.name: Privacy.Deleting
data.value: Parents can delete a child with all results at any time. To delete the whole family, contact the person who runs Lernkicker. Deleted data is gone at once; backups expire after their retention time.
